text: はー　はー　よう　きょうも　６のしまの　みなと　から　いっきに　およいで　きたぜ…！

structure.jp: はー　はー　よう
６のしまの　みなと　から
いっきに　およいで　きたぜ…！
structure.en: I swam here in one go!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action was done on the way to where the speaker is now. およいで　きた = 'came here swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way to push what you say. きたぜ = 'I came, man'.
